reason: Fix the harness defect that has now cost five scope signals on one task (S-0112-a489, S-0113-561a, S-0114-de08, S-0115-655b, S-0116-f2fa). forge stage amend-scope records added paths in .git/worktrees/<wt>/forge/scope_amendments.json and stage done honours them through amended_scope_paths, but delegate.py's compose_brief builds the brief's write-scope list from task['write_scope'] alone and never consults that function. So every fix round after an amendment hands the worker a stale scope: the file it must edit is blessed by the gate and invisible in the brief at the same time, and the worker correctly refuses. One-line union in compose_brief. factory/ is in workflow_prefixes so this is excluded from the task's measured product diff. Companion is mid-task so delegation cannot make this change.
